name: Ha Yu-mi
source:
2nd year in Yo-han high school. Classmate of the protagonist and a very close friend of [url=http://vndb.org/c3876]Mi-na[/url]. She has a calm attitude and because of their opposing characters, many find it surprising that they are friends. Her hobby is music and film appreciation. Her favorite music genres are unexpectedly metal and hard core.

[edited from [url=http://visualnovel.wordpress.com/2008/06/28/lost-number-heroines/]Visualnovel's Weblog[/url]]
